test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people are sitting around a circular table facing outwards- L, M, N, O and P. P is sitting to the immediate right of L. M is sitting second right from P. N is the immediate neighbour of P and M. Who is sitting to the immediate left of L?
solution: Five people are sitting around a circular table facing outwards- **L, M, N, O and P**. 1. P is sitting to the immediate right of L. 2. M is sitting second right from P. 3. N is the immediate neighbour of P and M.
